notes.title: Kainga: Update 1.2 "Points of Interest" is HERE!
notes.content:
Hello Kaingans!
As a solo developer, it is often hard to choose what to do with the limited time I have, and a lot of that time has been dedicated to my new project, the cozy urban building game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/][b]ShantyTown[/b][/url] which has [b]just launched a Demo[/b] (check it out!)

Every time I work on Kainga, I'm reminded of what makes this game so magical: [b][i]The World[/i][/b]. So I'm happy to finally release the next update which focuses on just that, [b]the world of Kainga![/b]

[h1]Introducing Kainga Update 1.2![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/0de38b470cf506c8c54cd348bf4d2ebaa8cbaf7e.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=CsTI93yEq5E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's New in the Update?[/h2]
Here's a brief list of just a few things introduced in the newest update, see the full in game patch notes to see the [b]hundreds[/b] of changes since patch 1.1.

[h3]This Update Adds:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added at least 12 Points of Interest including a witches hut, crenelations, new scrollkeeper variants, cemetery, etc.
[*] Added 3 new creatures
[*] Added 10 new house types to unlock
[*] Added a new secret unit
[*] Added rideable lily pads
[*] Grass and trees now blow in the wind
[*] Added tooltips to most progress bars
[*] Added a “Rewatch Intro” button in the settings
[*] Braves you have selected when placing a structure will go and build what you place
[*] Added collectable song tracks
[*] Added a small chance for all the Thinkers to jam out in the Skyloft
[*] Added new landscape generations
[*] Completely reimagined Ice Ridge with a new build algorithm and landscape pieces
[*] New map modifiers: Rising Tide, Hectic, Infested, Clearing, Pyramid, Mountain, Volcano, etc.
[*] Added new randomized cliff and sand textures to every map
[*] Added more Thinker-less towns with unique interactions (mercenaries and cannibals)
[*] Portuguese localization
[*] Added some secrets
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
There are a bunch of changes, but I thought I'd highlight a few that have been either highly requested or change the way certain things work
[list]
[*] Changed camera movement to right-click and hold (from middle mouse button)
[*] Sending braves to resources now defaults to them chopping (hold CTRL to just move them)
[*] Necromancer properly steals deaths
[*] Saved souls now only spawn at game start (not during festivals)
[*] Firejar passive only activates when braves are damaged by fire, instead of nearby fire
[*] Fire has been rebalanced spread slower in general, but faster in high winds
[*] Farms (including seaweed) now yeet resources directly at their worker
[*] AI now prioritizes combat over firefighting
[*] AI Thinkers no longer take inspirations until Ante 2
[*] The second Transport tech is more likely to spawn in reachable locations
[*] Dismantled ladders now give bamboo back
[/list]

[h2]What's Next for Kainga?[/h2]
I've been having a lot of fun jumping back into Kainga occasionally. I am aware that there are some foundational issues that still exist that are unfortunately so baked into the source they cannot be rooted out without re-creating Kainga itself...[i]which is not off the table![/i] (Kainga 2?)

I've also been toying with the idea of a "Skies and Caves" DLC.
What do you think?

[h2]ShantyTown - The Cozy Urban Building Game[/h2]
For now I'm dedicating my time to finish [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/]ShantyTown[/url] which should launch later this year.

Please [b]check out the Demo[/b] and leave feedback if you can!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3701340/ShantyTown_Demo/

[h2]On the Backs of Walkers... Again![/h2]
That's right! ShantyTown is set in the same universe as Kainga but a different timeline. This carries over to the language, foods and even creatures!

See the Devlog how [b]I added Walkers into ShantyTown![/b]
[previewyoutube=8vKuZUvHD3U;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/HCBzgkyd5r]Join us on Discord[/url] for all things Kainga and ShantyTown!
That's all for now, enjoy the update!
-KaingaDev

notes.title: Kainga in 2025
notes.content:
Happy New Years, Kainga fans!
I’m here to finally give you some [b]big news[/b] about the future of Kainga: Seeds of Civilization and [b]what to expect in 2025![/b]

[h2]Kainga Update 1.2[/h2]
I’ve been working on bringing some exciting new features to the game, including new creatures, technologies, and the new [b]points of interest system[/b]. 
I've also been trying to add controller support which has proven to be more difficult than I expected, but I’m making progress on it. More news on this to come, and if you want to try out the new update and help find issues, you can join the BETA branch and [url=https://discord.gg/HCBzgkyd5r]reach out on Discord![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/b1084f650c833db506c265df7125b7eb768e3193.png[/img]

[h2]I Started My Own Dev Company: Silk Softworks![/h2]
I’m really excited to announce that I’ve launched my own development company: [url=https://www.silksoftworks.com/][b]Silk Softworks[/b][/url]. I’m still a [b]solo developer[/b], but as I spread out to more projects in the future, I want to have them under one umbrella brand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/e017929591424bfb9a546102638e9b431db2a6ac.png[/img]

This may seem just symbolic, but it has allowed me to move into a self-publishing model this year, under the Silk Softworks brand. This means Kainga will no longer be published by Green Man Gaming and I've regained [b]full control[/b] of the game again! This has removed a roadblock in updates and you should see more activity here from now on :)

[h2]Previewing a New Project: ShantyTown[/h2]
While awaiting the transfer, I’ve also been working on a new game: [b]ShantyTown[/b]. It started as a tiny side project but has grown into something I'm quite proud of. ShantyTown is a relaxing city-block building game where you place objects one at a time to create a colorful, atmospheric and dense urban environment. I've been making ~monthly devlogs since the games conception, so if you're interested in the whole game-dev process, [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwnW8-pQYvBePhb3vCX8F5VhXFYBdcPqu][b]you can check that out here.[/b][/url]

If the game sounds like it’s up your alley, please do me a favor and wishlist it! It really does help.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/

Although a totally different genre, tone and game, the world of ShantyTown and Kainga are inherently linked! They even share the same phonetic language! (These characters are on the cover of the Kainga menu book)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/18233c4fbac6dcd7bd250c4a49160d84d661c903.png[/img]

[h2]Follow Silk Softworks for Future Updates on Both Kainga and ShantyTown[/h2]
If you haven’t already, be sure to follow Silk Softworks on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/silksoftworks.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] or join the Discord using the links below.

I'll also be streaming for the next few hours on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kaingadev]Twitch[/url], so if you want to drop in and see the update for yourself, please fell free to!

Thanks for reading, I’ll be sure to let you know when the new update goes live with a full description of what's included.
All my best,
Erik

notes.title: What's Being Worked on in Kainga?
notes.content:
Hello all!
I thought I'd pop by to give a little update on what's being worked on in the world of Kainga: Seeds of Civilization!

[h2]New Content[/h2]

First things first, there are a few houses in the game that are currently [i]not unlockable[/i] but a teaser to what's coming up. I should have hidden them but I didn't :) sorry!

I'm working on quite a bit for [b]update 1.2[/b] which of course includes new technologies, beasts and map modifiers. The main thing I'm working on is what I'm calling [b]"Points of Interest"[/b] which are locations that can spawn on any map similar to the Belowlands Karma Shop or the Necromancer's tower. These points of interest are things like NPC's to interact with, Thinker-less camps and new world mysteries and puzzles to be solved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/bb4ba44fad4afb91239b6828f4a5fbf66ee9a353.png[/img]

I have a bunch of ideas for potential points of interest but I'm always open to hearing yours! 

[h2]Technical Changes[/h2]

That's the fun stuff, but most of my time has been spent on fixes, keybinds reformatting and restructuring code to allow for things like proper UI and text scale to match standards of the Steam Deck and consoles. That's right! Kainga is getting controller support!

I had a lot of fun coming up with the control scheme and I think I've come up with some clever ideas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/62992ea2ee2dd6b06d4dde3314e2620985274348.png[/img]

If you want to be one of the first to help test this (and the new content features) be sure to hop on [url=https://discord.gg/9YEaZ53rmT]the Discord[/url] to keep informed on how you can help!

In addition to that, I'm working on some deeper features that have been highly requested like a [b]sandbox mode[/b], and I'm trying to come up with a good way for players to share the maps they generate!

[h2]Summer Sale![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269710/Kainga_Seeds_of_Civilization/

Kainga's currently on one of the deepest sales and seeing all the new players has been great. If you have questions or want to share your own ideas for Kainga [url=https://discord.gg/9YEaZ53rmT]the Discord[/url] is a great place to chat!

Please keep being awesome and have a wonderful day.
Thanks all,
-Kainga Dev

notes.title: The Necromancer's Tower
notes.content:
Hello villagers!

I've been working on some fixes for Kainga (full changelog at the bottom) and I thought I'd slip in something I've been working on and very excited about as well!



[h1]The New Necromancer's Tower[/h1]

Have you ever wondered why the 8th Thinker, Serrano, doesn't show up in the other towns in the belowlands? 

Well that's because he normally doesn't participate in the Thinker's games, and instead focuses on [b]necromancy [/b]and resurrecting the dead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/efe2a3db74fb7854c973e1bae6e99aa21433e0c3.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29389/Kainga_Seeds_of_Civilization_Collectors_Edition/ 

[b]I tried making my own unusual villages[/b] during a livestream while interviewing Drummond of Somepoint Sound, the musician of Kainga, as well as answering some questions from the community on Kainga's game design choices.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/13040a2ba0bf5958e0f44eda2cd778844ddf7109.png[/img]

Hello all!
Just doing a minor update (I'm still working on some [b][i]surprises[/i][/b] for the future!) but I thought it could be fun to do [b]an unusual village competition![/b]

As you well know, Kainga is a pretty weird game, so let's celebrate that weirdness with a competition! I've spiced up this post with some past creative examples for a bit of inspiration. I'm excited to see what you come up with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/f503221a88f47aad0278d5b64d597fb5f1cdcbd5.png[/img]
[i]-Elevated town by CaptainArex[/i]

[h2]Competition Ground Rules:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Villages don't have to be large, efficient or successful, just unique looking!
[*] You can use any map, any Thinker, any technology!
[*] You can submit more than one village!
[*] It would be nice if you named the town as well
[*] Submit your entry sometime between now and [b]October 31sr, 2023[/b]
[*] Submit images to the [url=https://discord.gg/4Edkar7C7Q]#share-your-village channel on Discord[/url] or directly to me at Thinker@KaingaGame.com
[*] Selection will occur on [b][url=https://discord.gg/YBbSaRamHc]Discord[/url][/b] on [b]November 5th[/b]
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/e01151f5e93cc256ce824bce013ad937c91e763b.png[/img]
[i]-Bridge entrance by Hyena[/i]

[h2]Tips for Taking Good Screenshots[/h2]

[olist]
[*] In game, press [b]"V"[/b] to remove the hud for a seamless image
[*] Use the mouse wheel [i]click[/i] to get a lower angle that looks really nice!
[*] Holding [b]CTRL[/b] will allow you to move the camera without it automatically changing its height
[*] Take a picture of the village's [i]most interesting part![/i] Not the widest shot :)
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/467240ba93c87d0447226c01abee665382012841.png[/img]
[i]-Interconnected by Quangphong[/i]

I'm excited to see what creations you come up with! The winner will get access to [b]a copy of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29389/Kainga_Seeds_of_Civilization_Collectors_Edition/]Collectors Edition[/url][/b] of Kainga, which includes an [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235420/Kainga_Seeds_of_Civilization__Digital_Artbook__Wallpapers/]artbook[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228070/Kainga_Seeds_of_Civilization__Soundtrack/]soundtrack[/url], as well as the glory of being the fanciest architect in the wild lands of Kainga!

notes.content:
[h1]The First Major Update After Launch![/h1]

[previewyoutube=VJdIf7if96g;full][/previewyoutube]

There's a lot in this update, but here are the key features:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/4335b8476d56c5bc04d4b75432801210fa0423b6.png[/img]
Possible variations to every map will keep each game spicy!
You might see a [b]tropical [i]Ice Ridge[/i][/b], acidic water, mysterious jars or geysers dotting the land or simply an [i]abundance of snails! [/i]

Map modifiers can affect what spawns, the weather, the resources and technologies available or the topography, sometimes dramatically changing the way you need to think about a map.

There's plenty of room for new ideas here, so if you have some ideas, please share them!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/07e6f7aeba807edbd579f39f09eef6d803ed7ffe.png[/img]

Alternative Thinkers for long-term players that will make you re-think your strategies, playstyles and favorites!

In addition to a swapped color palette, new Thinkers bring [b]new starting crews[/b], resources, passive technologies and bonuses. Each Thinker is focused around a key element of Kainga's world, which could be fire, war, relationships, ghosts or more. 

With each Thinker comes [b]3 new festivals[/b] and quests to unlock them and their memory slots.
Let me know your new favorite!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/94b3a2262714f1c67479ba5e71905b6c39a6f202.png[/img]

Doubling the number of festivals available to Kainga players was a tall order, but it had to be done to make the Thinkers feel totally unique! 

Each festival has a new [i]never-before-seen[/i] outcome and I'm excited to see the experimentation! 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/e4569bbf9a0c9a79e636578babea37abe97f8baf.png[/img]

3 of these new festivals are new challenges! 
I've added one of each category, a new arena challenge that costs an exotic resource, a new landmarks challenge that asks you to make a path of archways, and a new caged Thinker challenge, except this time [b]YOU'RE the one with the cage![/b] Defend against the AI's attacks and protect the cage to win!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/cd35cbf2cd7b1a2c950c86f83ab5cb31413f6e5f.png[/img]

The last and in my mind, most exciting thing added to Kainga are Nomads. These hostile units will wander past any of the maps [b]on boat, balloon or beast[/b] and may cause chaos as they clash with you or your neighbors!

This addition really [i]makes the world of Kainga feel [b]alive![/b][/i] I think you'll really enjoy seeing a town on the backs of walkers on the horizon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/cdc987fb2038308889325e2f0763d15dca521a14.png[/img]

I also have the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1269710/view/3687933234140411998][b]full changelog[/b][/url], if you'd like to check out all the minor differences.

I hope you enjoy the update!
As always, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/g3fCXNa]reach out on [b]Discord[/b][/url] to share your comments, ideas and screenshots!
-Kainga Dev

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g41z_CN97x0&list=PLwnW8-pQYvBePhb3vCX8F5VhXFYBdcPqu&index=4]You can follow the devlogs here:[/url]

notes.content:
Hello villagers!

I just want to give you a heads up that a [b]MASSIVE[/b] update is about to drop. 
I'm super excited, so in celebration: 
[h3]Kainga's on a [b]30%[/b] discount starting today![/h3]

[h1]Update 1.1: Life of Spice[/h1]
[h3]What's included?[/h3]

The [i]Life of Spice[/i] update has hundreds of fixes, quality of life improvements, balance changes and more, in addition to a plethora of new content. And actually, you can try [i]it out right now[/i], let's see how.

But first, here's just a few of the things that will be included:


[h3]Map Modifiers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/8486893be3556741c983da1fe308d853994162d6.png[/img]
New variations of every map will shake up your strategy and make the map's priorities change. Pictured above is the acidic water modifier on the Pebbles. You can no longer fish, and wells will be filled with acid. Be Careful!

[h3]"B-Sides" of Thinkers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/e4c9fa0aa5f48535dada9e7334b5334c2d302c22.png[/img]
Alternative sides of each Thinker can be unlocked with a new starting loadout, passive, bonus, and of course festivals. These Thinkers are intended for advanced players and can really shake things up!

[h3]Nomads[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/27c5afffc6bb74e1ee4af1a2e08861f6ef12e19e.png[/img]
Introducing nomads was something I've always wanted to do, and here it is! These nomadic tribes will wander across your map on boats, balloons, walkers or other creatures and really make the world alive!

[h3]New Festivals[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/0ca56ed64898e70adf01f11f03817586a42af93e.png[/img]
With the addition of the new Thinkers, new festivals had to come too! Each festival is changed dramatically and the results are powerful and specific. Enjoy!

[h3]New Challenges[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/92cb6fa57e0a240253e06e06a4f04931f2252d35.png[/img]
3 of the festivals added are [i]new challenges![/i], there is a blastpowder-based arena, a construction challenge to build a long line of archways, and alternative rescue challenge where you are the one with the cage and have to protect it!

[h3]New Quest Lines[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/131ce9874b35a1720b101add41420a17c22ffbf0.png[/img]
To introduce these new challenges, dozens of new quests have been added, allowing for the unlock of each Thinker's B-Side and their new memory slots, which will remain independent.

Also included is the [b]Polish Language[/b] thanks to one dedicated member of the community!

If you'd like to help with translations for your language, or you'd like to make changes to the translations there, let me know! I'm specifically looking for people who speak:

[*] Japanese
[/list]

[h1]When Can I Play It?[/h1]
The new update will go public around this time next week. But! [i]You can actually play it [b]right now[/b]![/i]

All you have to do is opt-in to the Kainga Beta, and you can try out what's new!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/868216456e5c54c040fa830095378e2a6adcf362.png[/img]
To join the Beta, just right-click on your game in your library, go to [i]Properties[/i], then [i]Betas[/i], and in the dropdown, select the beta branch

The reason why I'm telling you, is I'm hoping you can give me feedback, on what doesn't work as expected, what I missed, or what you think! Feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/g3fCXNa]contact me on [b]Discord[/b][/url] or [url=mailto:Thinker@KaingaGame.com]by email[/url] at any time!

notes.title: Update 0.9
notes.content:
Hello Villagers!

I've [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1269710/view/3443593298810414376][b]just announced the Full launch release on 6th December[/b][/url] - as you have supported me throughout Early Access, I wanted you to experience what I’ve been working on before full launch.

Take a look at the patch notes from the biggest update so far! So much has changed since the last update as I build the foundations for Version 1.0 and prepare to bring Kainga out of Early Access.

Let's dive into a handful of improvements below.

[b]NEW SKYLOFT HUB[/b]
The Skyloft has been completely reimagined and redesigned. There is more room for activities here, where the full roster of Thinkers can now chat and discuss their challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/46050d0e5e9272c83971fefdb82f3d0dbc009fb1.gif[/img]

[i]A preview of night event.[/i]

[b]MORE SUPPORTED LANGUAGES[/b]
Fully localized text for the entire game in 4 more languages:
- French
- Spanish
- German
- Chinese

If you speak these languages, please do let me know on Discord if you notice any issues or mistranslations!

[b]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
Something for you completionists! Also, the addition of endless quests for post-game Kainga masters. I’m super excited about this one!

[b]CHARACTER VOICES[/b]
To add more personality to the people of Kainga, I’ve updated the voices and sounds!

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
I’ve managed to fix hundreds of issues related to gameplay or performance and put the game in a better state than ever before. If you find any new issues, please report them to me in [url=https://discord.gg/NUuZE3aBHh ]Discord[/url]!

THERE WILL BE EVEN MORE TO COME IN FULL LAUNCH OF 1.0 ON DECEMBER 6TH.

- Erik

notes.title: Kainga's Progress
notes.content:
In addition to the next update "Wildlife", I've been focusing my efforts on improving and sanding down rough edges on what's already in Kainga! Let's see what's improved:

I won't go into any new content that's being added in just yet, only changes to gameplay you can expect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/146d3e4326414abe707b43ed78715bdcf2129446.png[/img]

[h3]New Synergy System[/h3]
I've been listening to feedback and the synergy system, or "unique" technologies as they're known in game, weren't clear and didn't allow for customization.

[b]Originally,[/b] if you had multiple techs that could synergize, it would pick one at random and grant it immediately. Many players didn't even realize the synergy had taken place, sometimes it caused problems and resource problems.

[b]Now,[/b] when a synergy is available, it will be granted similarly to other technologies, in a Thinker's ideas. This way you have the freedom to pick which synergy you'd prefer, or [i]deny[/i] them all! 
With over ** synergy technologies, it was a shame to see players not realize this was a part of Kainga!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/803451cd503318731e37a5b427901fc154702252.png[/img]

[h3]Memory System[/h3]
Late game players will know, that the memory system was a bit broken. 

[b]Originally,[/b] with all memories unlocked, you could start with 3 free techs in addition to the 3 starting nearby inspirations meant you were at 2 festivals almost immediately. This also made the search of technologies obsolete as it was often not even necessary to leave the campfire.

[b]Now,[/b] memories are [i]guaranteed [/i]to appear in that tech's category [i][b]once[/b][/i]! This ensures that you still are able to get the techs that you saved in memory, but don't [i]have[/i] to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/bb733fb02477d24560104c0eb66bf300bda841b6.png[/img]

[h3]Beast Improvements[/h3]
Many beasts now have different ways that they spawn, reproduce and can be killed. They also now have cloth banners when tamed to indicate which team they're on.


[h3]Other improvements[/h3]
In addition to the above, a lot of fixes have been made including to rarer techs like the Gosanke Harborhouse, a much needed improved system to get units out of boats, the ability to deconstruct and reconstruct all structures, improved town AI structure placements, claimed areas are now cylinders instead of spheres, and many, many bugfixes.

The goal here is to improve how Kainga feels to plan and make it a better experience overall.
Keep your eyes open the next post on the next update!
-Kainga Dev

notes.title: Kainga Update 0.6 - Clothing and Stone
notes.content:
[h2]What's new in 0.6?[/h2]

Each major Kainga update in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1269710/view/3104663815688184505][b]roadmap[/b][/url] is paired with a new playable map to introduce that update's mechanics. This update, [i][b]"Clothing and Stone"[/b][/i], is paired with the [b]Ice Ridge map[/b] which brings with it a new snow system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/f71d635adbdfc48d72fee2b0eec42f64d1ce8152.png[/img]

It took me a while to figure out how to make the snow deform properly, affect houses, water and your people as expected, but I'm really happy with how it turned out. 

There are new snowy weather events that can occur in some of the other maps, but are focused around this new map. [b]The Ice Ridge map[/b] is a multi-layered mountain where space and movement can be restrictive but logs, usually a rare resource, are in abundance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/e02c4e8fe939ccdc433553ca9cd02f4d34eea324.png[/img]

With the addition of snow comes a new way to deal with weather, clothing! 

I've drawn over 3000 new frames of animations and overlays to add visual flair to the new clothing and hat technologies, most of which upgrade the brave, but I also added new weapons to the synergized combat units.

Braves run around barefoot and don't have their arms covered, which isn't suited well for the snow, so I dressed them up in a new fur outfit. I also drew another outfit, made instead from silk, that doesn't protect from the cold but grants other benefits. 

On top of the outfits, I drew new hats including a thinking cap, a fez with pangolin back-armor and an enchanted headband that protects the brave's mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/8ebec23f95963473f9cd71444347ba274239270e.png[/img]

[b]Unique synergy units[/b] also got visual updates too!
The [i]shield bearer[/i] now has a copper tower shield, and the [i]axewarrior[/i] and [i]longbow[/i] use their correct weapons. [i]Bee bombers[/i] wear an ancient beekeeper's mask and poofy clothing that would be useful against bees, [i]acid bombers[/i] would have handled a lot of acid and thus have wrappings covering their burns, and [i]firebombers[/i] wear a helmet based on the firewarriors of [url=https://www.gog.com/en/game/populous_the_beginning]Populous: the Beginning[/url].

Finally, there's also a new Thinker, this time a Thinker-pair: Kala and Jeera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/ea3ea2265fedf0a639d630bc05e33c01fda9a4d2.png[/img]

This Thinker became inseparable from their beast once he fashioned a shell for this shell-less snail. Since then they've been granted the status of "Thinker" and are known as Kala and Jeera. They focus on a defensive playstyle, using [b]the new stone resource[/b], and have ways of uncovering the mysteries buried below the soil!

I also added stone, termite nests and the fir tree for this update as well. 
Finally, due to popular demand, you can now build walls, which look fantastic too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/053b19b53b6ac6ae9503425539e6e1462235e68e.png[/img]

With this update comes a massive list of bugfixes, QoL improvements and visual and audio enhancements. 

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1269710/view/3325361214990236133]Check out the [b]full changelog[/b] here![/url][/h3]

[h2]Bundles of Bundles:[/h2]

To celebrate the winter release, I'm doing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26960/Frozinga_Bundle/][b]Frozinga[/b][/url] bundle with Frozenheim the beautiful Nordic city-builder!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26960/Frozinga_Bundle/

Also available is the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26646/City_Builder_Bundle/][b]City Builder Bundle[/b][/url] which has 4 great indie city-builders all together!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26646/City_Builder_Bundle/

Thanks for being a Kainga fan, I couldn't be happier with the progress being made!
Until next time, 
-Erik

notes.title: Kainga Update 0.5 - Inventions!
notes.content:
[h2]Another major update is here![/h2]

The [b]"Inventions"[/b] update brings with it the most ambitious map yet, flying creatures explosive technologies and an expanded roster of vehicles for land, sea and air!

[previewyoutube=-MIeoN8K5ss;full][/previewyoutube]

This new update brings quite a bit to the table expanding on what's already in Kainga with some really exciting additions:

[h3]The Towers Map[/h3]
The most vertical map by far, with tall, narrow mountains of multiple elevations connected by ramps and arches. Lack of space and a surprising amount of interconnectivity can lead to some truly unusual games!

The Towers is a dream come true for me personally in gaming as I've always wanted to build in these extreme landscapes!

[h3]New Flying Creatures: The Firebird[/h3]
Floating effortlessly around the maps with its 17 wings, it can also propel itself high into the sky with a rocket between its 5 feet!

[h3]Technology Expansion[/h3]
In addition to more technologies, house types and vehicles (balloons, land-barges, and houseboats!) A new mechanic has been added that greatly expands the roster of technologies through [b]the new [i]synergy[/i] system[/b] which transforms known techs into something unique when a specific pair is acquired!

[h3]Charnushka and New Festivals[/h3]
Strong and noble, this Thinker proves his worth by carrying a mighty relic from a long lost time on his back which boosts the production of nearby buildings!

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
As always, I continue to tweak the balance of technologies, improve UI elements and feedback and adding basic QOL features like a randomize color button, tighter hitboxes for large house placements and also added cheat codes!

If you find issues or have suggestions, please feel free to reach out on [url=https://discord.gg/g3fCXNa][b]Discord[/b][/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/KaingaGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

[h2]Want to Watch the Dev Play?[/h2]
I played 6 games of Kainga to show off some of the new features, maps and technologies and talk a little about my thoughts behind the scenes which you're more than welcome to watch here!
[previewyoutube=91tuZdwzvRY;full][/previewyoutube]

There's also a [url=https://youtu.be/Mdna06gkPM8]longer version[/url], if you're interested, but it's the same set of games.

I plan to do more livestreams in the future, so I can explain my thoughts behind some design choices while playing Kainga. Also, if you're interested, perhaps a development livestream as well!

Please remember to write a review if you're enjoying Kainga as it really does help!
Until next time,
-Kainga Dev

notes.title: Inventions and Conventions
notes.content:
Hello Kaingans!

I've been working hard on the upcoming [b]"Inventions"[/b] update which will be arriving before the end of the month! 
Here's some news and information on what exciting new inventions are being worked on:

[h3]Conventions:[/h3]

First the big news: [b]I'll be taking Kainga to my first gaming convention![/b] I'll be at [i]PAX East[/i] in Boston between April 21st to April 24th! If you happen to be at the convention, swing by booth number [b]22057 [/b]and say hi!

[h3]Inventions:[/h3]

The main focus of this update (hence the name "inventions") is expanding the list of unusual technologies in Kainga. This is everything from elevators, drawbridges, and grenadiers to more creative things like the skyhook cannon, sea-mines and new land, water and air-based vehicles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/6807c1ca52fb05fe621e1373c19a07a371ad6c9c.gif[/img]

I've added dozens of new technologies including an entire set of unique [i]synergy [/i]technologies that only occur when two specific techs are selected. This will greatly increase the variety in your runs and I'm excited to hear feedback on this new system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/784ad24cba4c24e0216a711b4498474d6705884c.gif[/img]

In addition to technology, I've been working on the new region to be revealed in this update is [b][i]"The Towers"[/i][/b] and it is personally my most anticipated region. 

It's very extreme vertically and has an abundance of resources and fertility but a lack of space to expand. In comparison to the islands of [i]"The Pebbles"[/i], bridges connecting the rocky craigs create a high amount of accessibility while maintaining a feeling of isolation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/f25b6b51ad00cc2dc1dc348b710ee1fecc1c4c96.gif[/img]

It took a long time to get right, but I'm really happy with how it's turned out. I look forward to your responses on this new challenge!

As you can see in the gif above, there's also a new flying creature to be added in this upcoming update: the [i]Firebird[/i] which is actually based off of a real creature that swims underwater!

In addition to all that is above, I've added a new Thinker and of course been working to improve the AI, pathfinding and gameplay quirks.

See you in the belowlands of Kainga!

[i]-Kainga Dev[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.4 - Trade and Travel is here!
notes.content:
The first major update of Kainga is here! A LOT has been changed and added and as a result has become a much more rounded game.

Here's a short trailer showing off what's new!

[previewyoutube=3cfbPcsJSa8;full][/previewyoutube]

I've been working really hard for months on this update, ever since the early access release. It was way more ambitious than is should have been, and I considered splitting it in half, but I felt it would be better all at once. The focus of this update was to improve the interactions with the AI towns. In actuality, I went way beyond, adding new creatures, conversion units and a truly unique Thinker.

Each major update will include a map, and while designing this map, I thought to myself: "wouldn't it be cool if the landmasses occasionally moved?" I couldn't get that idea out of my head so I made it happen!

You can read [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1269710/view/3133946724559850822]the full changelog here[/url][/b], but here's a summary of what's included:

[h2]New Map: The Edges[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/42e52e12ef065fd51843d126103a47a6ddc31085.png[/img]
This new region is a gentle savannah in all directions interrupted only by deep cliffs down to the water. Available space and wood is a boon but access to nearby plots of land may be broken or granted by seismic earthquakes! 

[h2]Relationships, Trade, Gifts and Demands Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/a9a42b5a58373b116407c8e190689c6cb37cdb5b.png[/img]
A great many changes have been made to create a more dynamic relationships between each village. You (and the AI) can propose tradelines, make demands and give gifts which will each affect your relationship and how they behave!

[h2]New Challenge: Menhirs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/aeee96719a50c29977316416e513465b016fb848.png[/img]
This new challenge requires the player to locate massive enchanted stones from across the lands, drag them into your town and pull them upright to prove your mastery and succeed.

[h2]New Thinker: Ajowan[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/57d025d1f90453cf40cc53b7a9ba4fbd17649879.png[/img]
A completely unique Thinker that cannot be hurt due to being made entirely of smoke! When damaged, the Thinker returns to his massive jar, known as the Alabastron, which in turn must be protected from harm.

[h2]New Creatures: Mastadon and Totano[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/8726e49c03e4eb679bb54823108a2eeaabee15de.png[/img]
“Totano” and Mastadon - Two new gentle giants have been added, the squid-like Totano walks across the lands and occasionally seeds the soil below its massive frill. The mighty Mastadon is a shelled beast of burden that roams the grasslands in large packs and is unharmed by fire.

[h2]New Conversion Unit: Priests[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/3c773243e0faf15ce9e6473c6245ee5edde47f0f.png[/img]
Weak and slow priests do no damage to your enemies but instead can convert them to your side! This powerful unit can easily handle small numbers of units but can be overwhelmed and disrupted.

[h2]Wandering Trader Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/71ef0ff25b418889e506db653f6a2ad46d6121f3.png[/img]
The scrollkeeper can now enter the world below! Occasionally the wandering trader will travel from town to town to make resource exchanges.

[h2]New Quests[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/ea5cd4afc8cac5eb3a13bea97b8467ee495105da.png[/img]
A new menu has been added to track your quest progress and see what else is there to unlock, plus a number of quests have been added to earn the Edges map, the new thinker Ajowan and each of his memory slots.

[h2]New Technologies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/3fbddd1ab11d0dea56968d15d29b11be96cc52ae.png[/img]
As usual, more than 20 additional technologies have been added (pushing the total above 180) adding new festivals, new ways to train combat units, new beast attachments and more!

If you find any issues or bugs, please let me know on the [b][url=https://discord.gg/g3fCXNa]Kainga Discord[/url][/b] where I'm quite active.

Please remember to review Kainga, as it really does help a lot!

The next update is the "Inventions" update, so keep your eyes open on some new about this as well :D
Thanks so much and until next time!
-Kainga Dev

notes.title: Progress towards the "Trade and Travel" Update
notes.content:
Fist off, I want to state again that I'm incredibly impressed with how people are taking to Kainga!

Thank you so much for your positivity and engagement! 

[h2]News on the "Trade and Travel" Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/356e417ab3198f704e636c42ca42630e71b19212.gif[/img]

It's been a while since I posted an update on Steam and I'd like to explain why. Normally, I'd make minor updates [i]every few weeks[/i] but since one of the major changes in the "Trade and Travel" update was a fundamental change in how towns react to one another through the new relationship system. I unfortunately couldn't share any updates without sharing the whole system, and the system isn't yet complete, although very close!

[h2]What Can We Expect?[/h2]

There are dozens of major and minor changes, here's a quick look at 4 that you can look forward to:

[h3]1.) Trading and Relationships![/h3]
Gone are the days when you will get randomly raided just for existing. Actions you take will affect your relationships and you can now make trades, or give gifts to appease relations or demand resources from your enemies. Alliances will bring surprising perks!

[h3]2.) New Playable Thinker: Ajowan[/h3]
Ajowan is a new unique Thinker that you can currently see in the [i]Skyloft[/i], unlike all other Thinkers, he's incorporeal and made entirely of smoke! With just 1 health, death will only return him to his massive jar known as an Alabastron. If the Alabastron is broken, however, you will lose. 

[h3]3.) New Map: The Edges[/h3]
A kind of savannah, this new biome will offer an abundance of reeds and logs as well as a decent amount of space to build your town. However, traversal will be difficult as steep cliffs drop into the water. Who knows why the ground keeps ominously rumbling!

[h3]4.) New Challenge: Menhirs[/h3]
A new kind of Landmarks challenge except instead of simply building what you need, you need to find and gather these massive stones, pulling them back to your town before hoisting them upright to complete the challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/3d2fdc318d031fe1c5547d8d916775b686813784.gif[/img]

[h2]How Long Is It Gonna Take?[/h2]

I'm very close now, but I need some time to clean up what's already been created as well as around a week for bug-testing before the update is released.

Here's some fantastic villages created by some members of the Kainga community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/f0600e26a7682d2e833ca0f169edd6deb11fdc4d.png[/img]
A symmetrical town from [i]CaptainArex[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/8158ad49632bf0c7dd38871c4ca9a46ad33714d3.png[/img]
An intimidating boat army from [i]Rentier Riche[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/a715bbafbac9c8934533a6ab04bc144b2f267bc0.png[/img]
And a multistoried housing cluster from [i]Sandra Vea[/i]

[h2]Moving Forward[/h2]
As Kainga is in Early Access and there's personal investment to see the progress of development, I'm going to do my best to produce updates every few weeks without such large breaks in communication. 

If at any time, you'd like to contact me with anything about Kainga, feel free to reach out on [url=https://discord.gg/g3fCXNa][b]Discord[/b][/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/KaingaGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url] where I'm quite active! 
Come, join the community, share your village screenshots!

Feel free to also share your ideas for the game, I'm constantly adding things and making changes based on player suggestions, so keep it up!
See you at the next update!
All hail the snail.

notes.title: Winter Patch and Sale!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Kaingans![/h1]

[b]Happy Holidays, gifts are on the way![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/d1041853ea9d34791320af937eb58176f92a8924.gif[/img]

I've been really happy with the response to Kainga, people have really seen the potential in this game which has been amazing to see. In celebration, I've put [b]Kainga on sale at 15% off! [/b]

I've been working really hard to fix and further improve the game as much as I can ([i]see the full patch notes below[/i]) and I will continue to do so throughout this Early Access development! 
I've also been working on the [b]next major update[/b] working on things like improving the AI of other towns, adding trade technologies, creating the new map: [i]The Edges,[/i] and working on a new Thinker. Here's a sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/7e01952bb70178af9cf7cdafdedc7b0c394113a2.gif[/img]

This is [i][b]Ajowan[/b][/i], an incorporeal Thinker that actually cannot be destroyed! When damaged, he returns to his Jar, known as the [i]Alabastron[/i]. If the jar breaks, however, the game will be lost, so protect it carefully!

This Thinker is not yet playable in the game, but will be upon the next update, but you can check him out in the [i]Skyloft[/i].

Without further ado, I'll share with you the changes and fixes below:

[h1]Patch Notes, version 0.3.27[/h1]

[i][b]New Technologies:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Rifle Casern
[*] Fishmonger
[*] Runed Axes
[*] Sturdy Shovels
[*] Hearth Spikes
[*] Mighty Pie
[*] Sampan and Dragon boats
[*] Walker War Rig
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/b21fb1cfbfee8dfec59f94a0ba5bcbb42f514540.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Arrows and Rifles now do half damage to Thinkers
[*] Thinkers now heal from festivals
[*] Achiote no longer damages your own buildings
[*] Braves will carry starting resources if campfire is placed far from starting location
[*] Added a rudimentary “hold” command (T)
[*] Rifles can now shoot through resources
[*] Bracer is now improved so ranged units don’t even hit allied units. Fire at will!
[*] Added a new Thinker to the Skyloft: Ajowan (not yet playable)
[/list]
[b]Animations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rifleman now has all shooting animations
[*] Beastmasters now have attacking animations
[*] Added Garam and Achiote death animations
[*] Added more team colors to Beastmaster and Rifleman designs
[*] Added Thinker specific end-screen images, no more purple Sumac!
[/list]
[b]Structures[/b]
[list]
[*] Rain Collectors now fertilizes soil when filled
[*] Clay Pit can only be built once now
[*] Simplified house weather protections to None, Half and Full
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed how towns build and grow
[*] Bamboo grows further from its base and also changes soil type
[*] Umbrella “Hardwood” trees are now counted as 3 logs and will mark themselves for harvest when regrowing
[*] Added an Icebreaker event
[*] You can now shoot Walkers :(
[*] Challenge Festivals cannot be destroyed after being started
[*] Remembered techs pop-up one at a time
[*] Gave the player a bit more leniency when discovering techs before getting attacked
[*] Discovered techs now queue so you won’t lose potential techs when taming
[*] Unlocks in the Skyloft now show 1 at a time as well
[*] Added a symbol which indicates that a tech can be built only once
[*] Increased the amount of time it takes for resources to degrade
[*] Enemy towns can now tame wildlife
[*] Enemy towns now expand by claiming new lands (WIP)
[*] Enemy towns choose house types based on the resources around them
[*] Enemy towns will now build more ladders around their town
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/51e87e121e72a88baccfdd4149287acf4d6c20f1.gif[/img]

[i][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/i]

[b]Units[/b]
[list]
[*] Resources can be picked up from the top of any stack
[*] You can now walk from the edge of the deserts
[*] Achiote should no longer attack his rescuers
[*] Achiote will no longer be mini when coming from a cage
[*] Units no longer change skin color when getting trained
[*] Ranged units will no longer fidget and actually shoot while in close combat
[*] Ranged units can no longer shoot while moving
[/list]
[b]Structures[/b]
[list]
[*] Feasting Pot now creates warriors as intended
[*] Incense Memorial now requires people have died as intended
[*] Escape Sandsail will not appear on the Pebbles map but can now also ride on water
[*] Storage doors no longer spawn in the walls of some storage buildings
[*] Fixed a bug where production buildings would ignite multiple times
[*] Sturdy Construction now works on most buildings
[*] Beast structures can be re-built after being destroyed
[*] Resource totems can be built by multiple people now
[*] Resource totems can now be torn down
[*] Fixed the ladders on Tower Houses and Lamba Houses
[*] Fixed the UI and wait time on Barracks repairs
[*] Fixed a bug where hermits wouldn’t automatically construct and be managed
[*] Fixed a bug where the Foraging Hermit required an unknown resource
[*] The audio of destroying a building will now not play forever
[*] Your main Thinker will now jump out of the Escape Balloon as intended
[*] Skylines and Sandsail are no longer available in the Pebbles
[*] Fixed a bug where hotbar and actual construction materials would be slightly different
[/list]
[b]Water[/b]
[list]
[*] Icebreaker now rises and lowers with the tides
[*] Fixed boat movement confusion during flooding
[*] Boats can be built while flooded without being instantly submerged
[*] Edges of the water no longer float during floods
[*] Water will now appear underground throughout the flatlands
[*] Boats should no longer be able to move when on land
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Clicking notifications while placing will no longer break the game
[*] Starting to-do list shows correct amount of desired houses
[*] Crustaceans will no longer bury your campfire underground
[*] Walkers should no longer be always leaning forward sometimes
[*] Towns should no longer build on access ramps
[*] Notification should still be clickable even after the notifying actor has been killed
[*] Fixed a crash after spearmen killed a charging Flathead
[*] Expired demands now properly initiate raids
[*] Soil should change to sand on the shores of the Pebbles
[*] Fixed the UI text overflow for the reward titles on the map
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue where the main Thinker didn’t spawn in the Skyloft
[*] Fixed collision on the tall cacti
[*] Trudgers can no longer walk on the water splash of cacti
[*] Raids and demands won’t use boats when they don’t need to
[*] Fixed a bug where braves would go get the wrong resource after their resource was taken
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37098409/e57fea09c246bfb2bfbc4897a879a9832cd228ed.gif[/img]

That's it for now!
Keep your eyes open in January for more info on the next update, I look forward to sharing the trade mechanics with you then.

Happy holidays!
-KaingaDev

notes.title: Kainga Patch 0.3.21
notes.content:
Hello Kaingans!

I've got another hotfix patch here to repair a lot of common issues players have been having, and hopefully smooth the experience more. Hopefully this will be my last patch that doesn't include anything new! But there continues to be issues I'd like to get fixed for you, so I've been keeping my focus. 

I've fixed the issues with widescreen and the bindable keys which was critical in my mind. I have made steps in improving ladders and boats, but please be patient as I continue to make them behave as expected.

[i]Next step[/i] is to work on how the [b]AI build and grow their towns![/b]


If you're interested in diving into the full change-log, please see below:

[i]Version 0.3.21[/i]

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Firetower range has been reduced
[*] Changed the Scented Candle from luring all nearby beasts to 1 from a great distance
[*] Rescued Thinkers are now invulnerable for a little time after being rescued
[*] Changed a lot of the tech names to be more distinct from one another
[*] Movement inspirations will no longer spawn in unreachable locations
[*] Viewport is no longer bound to 9:16 aspect ratio (widescreeners may cheer!)
[*] Had to change wooden nails from 0 hammers to 1 to allow for dismantling
[*] Reduced the cost of constructing barracks and docks
[*] Nerfed Clay Huts a bit (60% chance)
[*] Blueprint turns red when entrance is blocked too
[*] Updated the music with new tracks
[*] Updated the map to increase clarity
[*] Reroll button is blocked when you only know less than 5 techs in that group
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Q and E won’t be bound to the same key (please rebind both!)
[*] Fixed the key-bindings, they should actually save now
[*] Wooden Nails now affects Resource Totems
[*] Thinkers in cages will no longer get attacked
[*] You will no longer delete a key binding when swapping between 2
[*] Units should no longer “fall” into the tops of snails
[*] Hiding the hud (V) no longer requires you to have the hud hidden to push buttons
[*] Fixed the issue with “ghost boats”. I ain’t afraid of no boats.
[*] Towns with docks will no longer put their demand table in their own town
[*] To-do list updates during the Rescue challenge
[*] Fixed the selection priority between rescue structure and rescue boat
[*] Resources can still remain claimed while unreachable (on other islands)
[*] Overlapping territories no longer double-count resources
[*] Units are less likely to slip into the water during a flood
[*] Thinkers can no longer claim unreachable inspiration
[*] Archers should no longer shoot themselves in the back
[*] Fixed a lot of issues when building stilts
[*] Endscreen techbox now adjusts to situations with a lot of techs
[*] Achiote will now properly forget enemies when commanded to leave combat
[*] Removed Favor from Thinker selection menus (legacy)
[*] Fixed a graphical bug in the Skyloft
[*] You can now place structures in overlapping regions correctly
[*] Team colors should unlock as intended and appear in the end screen statistics
[*] Fixed an issue where your starting resources were not being counted
[*] Tooltips will no longer overstay their welcome on the endscreen
[*] Hermits will now be automatically managed
[/list]

Thanks for being so positive and enjoying the game!
I'm aware this is a mighty list, and also aware there are still more issues to get to. I'm also really happy with the reception and response from the community. 

So thanks again, and have a great day!
-KaingaDev

notes.title: BETA 0.2.17 Patch
notes.content:
Thanks for playing the BETA!

As you may have noticed, there were a few bugs and problems that would occasionally come up during gameplay. With your feedback, I've been able to remove most of them as well as make some changes to improve the gameplay experience. 

There are so many interacting systems in Kainga, it's hard to catch all the ways things can go wrong on my own. So your bug reports really do help!

Please report any bugs to [url=https://discord.gg/g3fCXNa][b]the Discord channel[/b][/url] where I'm most active and can see them quickly![h1]
[b]0.2.17 Changelog:[/b][/h1]

[b]Major Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed selection from 3D world-space to 2D screen-space
[*] Spearman now attack twice in quick succession
[*] Hotbar technologies are now bound to the number keys
[*] Barracks can now be destroyed and dismantled (finally)
[/list]
[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clay resource nodes aren’t destroyed when placing over them, and instead marked to be removed
[*] Some settings maximum was limited to High instead of Cinematic (Unreasonable)
[*] Reed Farms, Crop Rows and Crop Paddies now cost resources to build
[*] The “War” tech group can be used twice
[*] The Skypole now has diminishing returns (and grants only 1 karma)
[*] You can shift-click for 1 and ctrl-click for 5 units in the hotbar (still imperfect)
[*] You can right-click the hotbar units to zoom to them
[*] The Watchtower and Silk Awning now cost just 1 favor
[*] The Watchtower is now required to get alerted for raids
[*] Changed the way trees block navigation. Narrow paths should no longer be blocked
[*] Arrows now match team colors
[*] Found an inventive way to trap the Thinker during the rescue mission when no enemy camp is suitable
[*] Changed and fixed some icons
